title: A deep link resolved for an account that left the screen stays in that account's session and fires when the user switches back
trigger: Click a t.me link in account A (or a Join link), immediately switch to account B; the lookup finishes in A's background session (ChatReady/Ui/Info/ShowText). Switch back to A minutes later.
effect: On return, the next poll consumes the stale terminal state: a chat opens, a settings page or an info box appears unasked, in the main window (the flow_window was lost with the old OnScreen). Only the queued link is filtered by account (for_screen); the in-flight/terminal DeepLinkState in the session is not cleared on switch.
fix: Make the flow an OnScreen-owned value (one enum with origin account, window and agent flag) and clear or ignore session.deep_link answers whose screen epoch differs when the account leaves the screen.

title: Deep-link flow origin is kept by hand in three places beside the flow state
trigger: Any link click
effect: The flow stage lives in Session::chats_state.deep_link while its origin (agent flag, asking window, window the resolved link waits for) is in ChatsState::deep_link_from_agent, LinkUi::flow_window and LinkUi::pending_flow_window; pump_deep_link takes and puts them back in step on every poll.
fix: One enum DeepLinkFlow { Idle, Resolving{origin}, Invite{origin,..}, Resolved{origin,result} } with Origin { agent, window } inside each variant.

title: A pending linked media timestamp seeks and plays/opens media while the app is locked
trigger: Click a t.me/c/..?t=30 link to a voice note whose message is not loaded yet, then lock Quill (auto-lock or manual) within 12 s.
effect: pump_deep_link calls tick_media_seek before the refused_while_locked return; when the message loads under the lock, seek_media_timestamp starts voice/audio playback or opens the media viewer behind the lock screen.
fix: Move tick_media_seek after the refused_while_locked check (the seek stays pending and runs after the unlock), or hold it as a lock intent.

title: A thread/media link for a chat that has its own window opens the thread in the asking window's state
trigger: Have chat C open in its own window W and the main window showing another chat; click a t.me/c/C/msg?thread=T link in the main window.
effect: finish_typed_link runs open_thread_view in the asking frame (main) after route_chat_open sent the chat to W: flush_leaving_draft saves main's composer as leaving, and the driver's single thread slot is opened for C while main shows another chat, so main's advance_thread may jump to C duplicating W.
fix: Run finish_typed_link inside in_window_scope(Some(chat_id)) in the windowed branch, like attach_shared_qr_card.

title: A link whose lookup cannot be sent does nothing and shows no error
trigger: Click a t.me link while the chats path is not active or the sender is closed (reconnecting).
effect: request_deep_link_info_from, continue_deep_link and request_deep_link_text results are dropped with let _ =; the queued link was already taken, the flow state is None, nothing is shown.
fix: On Err put the link back in the queue or set a StatusNote::error (Couldn't open the link).

title: A one-time bot keyboard is dismissed and deleted at TDLib even when the button's text was not sent
trigger: In a slow-mode group (or while the send fails) press a button of a one_time reply keyboard.
effect: press_custom_keyboard_text dismisses the keyboard locally and calls deleteChatReplyMarkup before send_command_text, which returns early on slow_mode_blocked or no session and notes an error on send Err. The command is unsent and the keyboard is gone for good.
fix: Dismiss only after send_snapshot returned Ok (make send_command_text return whether it sent).

title: A one-time keyboard's poll-request button deletes the keyboard when the poll box is opened, not when a poll is sent
trigger: Press a one_time RequestPoll keyboard button, then cancel the poll box.
effect: dismiss_custom_keyboard (local hide + deleteChatReplyMarkup) runs on click before open_poll_dialog_locked; cancelling leaves no keyboard and no poll.
fix: Carry the keyboard key in the poll dialog and dismiss when the poll is sent.

title: Country box says Loading countries forever when getCountries fails
trigger: Open the poll Allowed countries or the shipping country box while offline or when getCountries errors.
effect: fetch_countries result is dropped (let _ =) and an error answer leaves auth_state.countries None; an empty list renders as Loading countries... with no retry or error until the box is reopened.
fix: Use Fetch<Vec<Country>> for the list so failed shows an error row with Retry.

title: Custom emoji card stage spread over a per-window tap marker, a seen copy and a session-wide preview
trigger: Tap a custom emoji in a message.
effect: custom_emoji_tapped (window), custom_emoji_card_seen (window) and Session::stickers.custom_emoji_preview (session) are set, compared and cleared by hand in tap, render, timer and both buttons.
fix: One enum CustomEmojiCard { Hidden, Asked{emoji}, Shown{preview, shown_at} } per window, with the session preview only as the answer.

title: Tapping the same custom emoji again while its card shows does not restart the 6 s timer
trigger: Tap emoji X, wait 5 s, tap X again.
effect: custom_emoji_card_seen already equals the preview, so no new timer is spawned; the first timer clears the card 1 s later. Likewise the timer of one window clears the session-wide preview for another window showing it.
fix: Give each tap a token in the card state and compare it in the timer.

title: Chrome-notify pending flag and due list are two cells kept in step
trigger: Scroll a history with stale-chrome rows during a session change.
effect: chrome_notify_pending (Cell<bool>) says a deferred notify is scheduled while chrome_due holds the rows; finish_chrome_notify and clear_slot_chrome_notify must reset it for the right window or notifies stop.
fix: Make chrome_due an enum ChromeDue { Idle, Due(Vec<usize>), Notifying(Vec<usize>) } in one RefCell.

title: Demo apply_demo_sticker/gif/edit/delete/pin_toggle/forward/archive/pin/marked_as_unread/notification_settings/message_sender number envelopes from demo_ui.seq without catching it up to session.last_seq
trigger: In a screenshot demo, before any album/outgoing send (the only two paths that fetch_max the counter), delete a message, pin one, send a sticker or GIF, archive a chat or mark it unread; or after QUILL_DEMO_UPDATE_STREAM has run (apply_json advances session.last_seq without touching demo_ui.seq)
effect: Session::apply drops the envelope as out-of-order-ignored (seq <= last_seq), so the action silently does nothing until the counter has caught up by repeated attempts
fix: One helper that stores last_seq into demo_ui.seq before every demo apply (as demo_apply_jsons/demo_delete_message do), or give the demo a single sequencer type that owns both counters, instead of syncing in some callers by hand.

title: Update stream keeps two sequence counters (DemoUi::seq and Session::last_seq + 1) in step by hand
trigger: QUILL_DEMO_UPDATE_STREAM combined with any later demo action using demo_ui.seq
effect: The stream advances session.last_seq without advancing demo_ui.seq, so later demo envelopes are dropped as stale (see 09-P03-001)
fix: Have the stream number its envelopes through demo_ui.seq (copy_and_parse) so there is one counter.

title: Terms prompt step and age tick are never reset, so the next terms update opens on a stale step with the age box pre-ticked
trigger: Accept terms (age box ticked) or tap Decline then Decline and Delete; later the server sends another updateTermsOfService (or the first prompt is cleared from another device while the step is DeclineSorry/DeleteWarning)
effect: The new terms prompt opens straight on the Decline sorry / Delete account step instead of the terms text, or with the minimum-age confirmation already ticked so the user never confirms their age for the new terms
fix: Hold one TermsPrompt { terms_id, stage: Terms{age_ok, age_error}|DeclineSorry|DeleteWarning } keyed by the terms id; replace it whole when notices.terms changes or clears.

title: Agree and Continue ignores a failed acceptTermsOfService send, so the locked terms box does nothing and says nothing
trigger: Terms box open (not closable), network/sender down so driver.accept_terms returns Err (terms_in_flight reset to false)
effect: Tap Agree and Continue: button flashes back to idle, no error text, no toast; the box cannot be closed, user is stuck without feedback
fix: On Err set notices.terms_error (or a status note) from the send error; model terms acceptance as Fetch<()> with the error shown in the box.

title: Force-logout notice is dismissed before the logout request is sent, and a failed logout send is dropped
trigger: AUTH_KEY_DROP service notice shown; press Log out while request_logout returns Err (auth not Ready, sender error)
effect: The locked notice vanishes, the account stays on screen as if usable though the server dropped its key, no error shown, no way to get the notice back
fix: Dismiss the notice only after request_logout returns Ok (or when the LogOut answer lands); on Err keep the notice and show an error.

title: dismiss_account_notice pops a force-logout service notice although its dialog is meant to be undismissable
trigger: Force-logout (AUTH_KEY_DROP_*) notice open (Esc, backdrop and close button disabled); any programmatic close of the AccountNotice kit dialog runs the registered close (agent-blocked layer close, close_window_boxes, left-dialog close in shell)
effect: The notice that must end in Log out is popped and never shown again; user is left in a dead session
fix: The Service arm of dismiss_account_notice should do nothing when the front notice is_force_logout, as the comment above it says.

title: Device-link flow is three Options kept in step by hand (scanner, scanned link, notice)
trigger: Settings > Devices > Link device: scan or paste, confirm, wait for Telegram
effect: No bug today; stages Idle / Scanning / AwaitingConsent / WaitingForTelegram / Done(notice) are spread over device_qr_scanner, device_login_qr and device_link_notice, with scan_device_qr and paste_device_login_link each re-checking a different subset
fix: One enum DeviceLink { Idle, Scanning(Scanner), Consent(link), Waiting, Result(DeviceLoginResult|Error) }; Waiting leaves on the DeviceLoginResult answer.

title: 'Waiting for Telegram to link the device' notice has no exit if the answer is consumed off the Devices page
trigger: Confirm a scanned device, then leave Settings > Devices before the answer lands, return later
effect: poll_device_qr returns early (clear_device_qr) while the page is not Devices, leaving device_login_result in the session; on return the stale Linked/Failed result shows as a fresh notice, and if the answer never lands the Waiting notice sticks until the page is left
fix: Make the Waiting stage of the DeviceLink enum leave on the answer regardless of page, and clear a stale result on leave_devices.

title: Demo setup uses assert! (panics) in the downloads and voice demos
trigger: Run --screenshot-demo ready-downloads or ready-voice when the playback intent logic regresses
effect: Process panics at demo start; only reachable in the screenshot demo build (lines 205, 208, 331, 336)
fix: Return an error/log note instead of assert!, or move the checks into tests.

title: Marketplace gift purchase is loading/sending/completed bools plus a note, seeded by hand in the demo
trigger: Gift marketplace box
effect: No bug found in this shard; the demo builds GiftPurchase with loading:false, sending:false, completed:false, so any combination of the three can exist
fix: enum GiftPurchaseStage { Quoting, Quoted(GiftQuote), Sending, Completed, Failed(String) }.

title: Storage statistics are an Option plus storage_stats_loading bool, set together by hand
trigger: Settings > Data and storage
effect: No bug found here; the demo sets storage_stats = Some(..) and storage_stats_loading = false separately
fix: Use Fetch<StorageStats> (idle/loading/ready/failed).

title: Saved-GIF panel is open + loading bools beside the list, set by hand before the answer
trigger: Open the GIF panel
effect: No bug found here; fixture sets gifs.open = true and gifs.loading = true then applies the answer, which must clear loading
fix: GifPanel { open, items: Fetch<Vec<Gif>> }.
